publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Guilherme Sabino

record.title: Stock 3.1.3 Camera with a kernel JPEG provider
record.method: Owner hand test, separate storage readback and clean-design inspection
record.observation: The accepted clean route keeps Apple userland text unchanged and serves stock H1ISP/IOSurface and AppleJPEGDriver clients. Preview, shutter, thumbnail, Photos and reboot persistence are owner accepted. Sensor acquisition is 640 × 480; 1600 × 1200 output is resampled.
record.limits: The first successful hand test lacks concurrent UART; no pre-reboot JPEG digest exists for a byte-identical persistence claim. Higher-detail sensor modes and measured 3.1.3 preview throughput remain unaccepted.

exhibits.title: Reviewed acceptance boundaries
rows: The accepted clean route keeps Apple userland text unchanged and serves stock H1ISP/IOSurface and AppleJPEGDriver clients. Preview, shutter, thumbnail, Photos and reboot persistence are owner accepted. Sensor acquisition is 640 × 480; 1600 × 1200 output is resampled.

The first successful hand test lacks concurrent UART; no pre-reboot JPEG digest exists for a byte-identical persistence claim. Higher-detail sensor modes and measured 3.1.3 preview throughput remain unaccepted.
exhibits.interpretation: Original editorial summary. The selected fields below retain the validation record’s scope.

exhibits.alt: Unmodified stock Camera screenshot saved on the physical PinePhone, showing an upright robot model and thumbnail
exhibits.caption: Stock 7E18 Camera screenshot recovered from physical private-data storage. It shows upright preview and thumbnail, not a measured frame rate or native 1600 × 1200 sensor detail. The first hand-test UART gap remains explicit.
